name: jev-reader-option-shuffle-invariance-v1
purpose: Audit fixed identifiers, candidate order, action order and a neutral title-frame on the same exposed source-reviewed dev prefixes.
scheduling: After the two declared shuffle jobs close, serial GPU2 inference, same five views/30 positions/seed; no model selection.
limits: Same exposed dev prefixes, not policy QA or independent confirmation.
Title-frame adds Passage titled: to each unchanged title; not a substantive paraphrase robustness claim.
Candidate order and option order are separate interventions.
All four final-epoch models included; no outcome-based selection.
No source/body removal, SHA or alternative fingerprints, test loading, HTTP, new ledger, service/default changes.
supersedes: New shuffle checkpoints only; existing fixed-option soft-CE probes are reused for comparison and not rerun.
